clips.title: The story
paras: At the Moonkin Stone east of Auberdine, Cenarion Moondust calls forth Lunaclaw. Night elf druids use the sacred powder in their trial to become Druids of the Claw.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker gives Cenarion Moondust to young druids in Darnassus for their final trial of heart and body. To face Lunaclaw, the guardian, an initiate travels to the moonkin dens east of Auberdine in Darkshore. Scattered on the ancient Moonkin Stone, the powder summons Lunaclaw to test the druid in combat. Through the trial, the initiate takes in the enduring strength needed to channel the bear form.
